title: Handle non-invoice or currupt PDF extraction
summary: E-document extraction now detects non-invoice or corrupt PDFs that return empty data and stops with a clear error, preventing creation of empty drafts and unnecessary vendor searches.
key_points: Added detection for ADI responses with no meaningful extracted invoice data (non-invoice documents, blank or corrupt PDFs)
Stops the structure step with actionable error message instead of creating empty draft
Valid header and line values continue to be preserved and processed normally
New manual 'Create draft' action available on purchase draft page and Payables Agent
Added comprehensive tests for detection of empty extraction responses
